scope: All explicit test directions in HPGM_POST_CONTACT plus recent relay/RR1 follow-ups and linked older test families. Older details remain canonical in NEXT_TEST_APPROACHES and EXPLORATION_BACKLOG_STATUS. Entries can be families, not individual run schedules.
execution: Saved research queue, not an automatic scheduler. A queued entry has no executed scientific result. Instrument checks are separately labeled.

entries.title: Reset-reader finite comparison
entries.question: Preparation assumptions versus retained history.
entries.comparison: 675 finite toy cells; preserves failed source prediction.
metrics: Scoped numerical results; no actual-agent efficacy

entries.title: Fresh-reader recovery pilot
entries.question: Can fresh readers preserve corrections through authored handoffs?
entries.comparison: Four arms and three hops, one chain per arm.
metrics: Corrections retained; detail omissions; evaluator-input repair

entries.title: Forecast scoring instrumentation
entries.question: Can we score explicit probability forecasts without equating Brier loss with calibration?
entries.comparison: Known-answer software fixtures and rejection of invalid inputs.

entries.title: Operations versus phase labels
entries.question: Do operations help, and do the HPGM names add anything?
entries.comparison: Competent ordinary, generic continuation, functional checkpoints, identical checkpoints with HPGM names.
needs: Independent cases and source-grounded answer keys

entries.title: ORIENT and DREAM ablation
entries.question: Which gate operations matter and do they interact?
entries.comparison: 2x2 pre-action orientation / post-action review, same evidence and declared budget.

entries.title: Closing record judged by next reader
entries.question: Does the closing artifact improve the next agent's orientation?
entries.comparison: Identical reader guidance; writer condition varied; reader sees only assigned final record and common task.
needs: Fresh reader packets; document shared-access limitations

entries.title: Review versus extra generation versus retrieval
entries.question: Is any effect from reviewing, more generation, or new evidence?
entries.comparison: Hold supplied evidence fixed for extra-generation/review contrast; vary retrieval as a separate factor.
needs: Matched evidence and explicit retrieval access

entries.title: Literal waiting intervention
entries.question: Does elapsed waiting change outcomes when information and computation are held fixed?
entries.comparison: Prespecified zero/short delay with identical inputs and call budgets; log external changes.
needs: Short nonblocking scheduling; no evidence changes

entries.title: Flow/pause schedule sweep
entries.question: Is 25% review allocation useful relative to alternatives?
entries.comparison: Prespecified several review-budget shares under one total budget; label token allocation versus elapsed time explicitly.

entries.title: Calibration and skip-review effect
entries.question: Does omitting a defined integration operation change forecast quality or reliability?
entries.comparison: Gate/no-gate with matched evidence and resource caps; do not assume the post's 22%.
needs: Observed labels for explicit forecast events
Enough repeated tasks for any population calibration inference

entries.title: Cycle frequencies and nesting
entries.question: Are 4.4/60 rhythms observed rather than imposed by the schedule?
entries.comparison: Define cycle clock and observable; compare null/surrogate traces, driven schedule, and unconstrained behavior.
needs: Prespecified nulls; no harmonic claim from a ratio

entries.title: Architecture transfer
entries.question: Do any measured gate effects transfer across model families?
entries.comparison: Frozen protocol across separately configured models, same task families; log ancestry and access.
needs: Frozen successful or failed first-family protocol

entries.title: Original quantitative-claim reconstruction
entries.question: Can million-cycle, 22% and p<.001 claims be reconstructed?
entries.comparison: Obtain original logs, definitions, analysis code, independent-unit structure and ablation specification.
needs: Original experiment artifacts not supplied with the post

entries.title: Phase count and ordering
entries.question: Do six labels or one order add value beyond the same operations?
entries.comparison: Group identical checks into fewer stages; compare dependency-respecting orders without changing evidence or work.
needs: Fixed operation set and valid order constraints

entries.title: Adaptive versus fixed gates
entries.question: Can observable failures trigger useful review at lower cost?
entries.comparison: Fixed gate schedule versus prespecified triggers based on observable errors/missing evidence, matched intervention caps.

entries.title: Physical analogy boundary
entries.question: What operational observations would distinguish a time-crystal claim from an imposed workflow?
entries.comparison: Specify drive, observable and symmetry claim before any physical analogy is promoted.
needs: Actual physical or formal model; repeated labels alone are insufficient

entries.title: Unknown reset-preparation reader
entries.question: Can a reader average over unknown preparation protocols, and where does conditional risk remain?
entries.comparison: Known preparation, declared mixture over preparations, confident wrong preparation; no new kernel tuning.
needs: Prospective mixture/prior rule and acceptance conditions

entries.title: Probability-weighted backward states
entries.question: How do backward support, multiplicity and probability partitions differ?
entries.comparison: Fixed finite Life system under separately declared initial and stationary ensembles.

entries.title: Boundary-channel identity and dissipation
entries.question: Does recording route identity recover irreversibility erased by flux aggregation?
entries.comparison: Lumped labels versus boundary-channel record; histories matched at declared physical time.
needs: Observation/clock convention fixed; preserve binary control

entries.title: Robust mixture recovery
entries.question: Do more probe counts and model checks improve recovery under near-collision or wrong response laws?
entries.comparison: Four-point versus overdetermined fits; held-out probe counts; one/two components; nonexponential/coupled rivals.
needs: Estimator comparison and data-generating laws fixed

entries.title: Real-agent provenance and moving context
entries.question: Do correct, missing and wrong source-preparation metadata change use of a retained record?
entries.comparison: Matched summaries/context lengths with randomized provenance accuracy and retrievable originals.

entries.title: Field/log observers and probe disturbance
entries.question: Which carrier or observation preserves continuity?
entries.comparison: Field/log/both/mismatched records; erase/sham; probe/no-probe; delays and positions.

entries.title: Wake-to-law escape and reversibility
entries.question: When are routes merely sticky versus inaccessible?
entries.comparison: Maintained/decaying/unbounded reinforcement versus support deletion across horizons/interventions.

entries.title: Transformer context/cache controls
entries.question: Separate token history, cache representations, position and decoding effects.
entries.comparison: Invented mappings; donor/neutral contexts; positions; eviction versus complete cache rebuild; fixed logits for temperature.

entries.title: Optimizer consistency versus curvature
entries.question: Does the corrected controller add value beyond ordinary or curvature-informed optimization?
entries.comparison: Matched-gradient quadratics, independent moment/parameter resets, AdamW and informative controller baselines.

entries.title: General FRR effectiveness
entries.question: Does FRR improve useful behavior at acceptable cost?
entries.comparison: Ordinary/compact/full guidance plus a separate record-access treatment on independently authored tasks.

entries.title: Role rotation and evidence lineage
entries.question: Do semantic role changes help when provenance is unknown or wrong?
entries.comparison: Role policies with equal realized intervention budgets and explicit provenance errors.
needs: Actual agent-role implementation and calibrated triggers

entries.title: Swarm boundaries and scale
entries.question: Do agent groups form useful boundaries beyond constructed conductance effects?
entries.comparison: Reasoning-agent groups with geometry, degree, evidence and budget controls.
needs: Runnable bounded swarm and raw logs; no inherited scale constants

entries.title: Shared-weight subspace robustness
entries.question: Does the paper's shared structure survive functional and alignment controls?
entries.comparison: Architecture/provenance alignment and functional preservation checks.
needs: Verified paper/code availability and exact claim selected

entries.title: DecepEval actor/evaluator contact
entries.question: Separate delivery of evidence, access, use, behavior and strategy.
entries.comparison: Matched actor/evaluator experiments with actual evidence packets and known evaluator-error controls.

entries.title: Subreddit timeline and idea scouting
entries.question: What earlier ideas, corrections and unexplored directions can inform current work?
entries.comparison: Read posts as dated sources; trace original evidence and edits; avoid counting cross-posted claims as independent support.
